sentences.text:

Others on 18 April, 2023

Bench: A.S. Chandurkar, M. W. Chandwani
 1 WP2458-23.o
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur
 Writ Petition No. 2458/2023
 (Sarangdhar Gopal Ghyar Versus Collector, Buldana & Others)
Office Notes, Office Memoranda of Coram,
appearances, Court's orders of directions Court's or Judge's order
and Registrar's orders.
 Shri H.R. Gadhia, counsel for the petitioner.
 Coram : A. S. Chandurkar And M.W. Chandwani, Jj.
Date : April 18, 2023.

entities.text:
High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench, Nagpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that in view of the registered Will-deed dated 28.11.2007, he alone is entitled to receive compensation for the land as acquired.

Though the respondent no.3 has raised an objection before the Sub-Divisional Officer, there is no reference made under Section 76 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Issue notice to the respondents returnable in four weeks.

3. Learned Assistant Government Pleader Shri A.A. Madiwale waives service of notice for the respondent nos.1 and 2.
 (M.W. CHANDWANI, J.) (A. S. CHANDURKAR, J.)
